local_patches.description: Preserve Mac offline bundled plugin-source installation inside current write-ahead journal; no stock Hermes changes.
Retain stock-builder link lifecycle and plugin fingerprint journal alongside the managed Mac offline plugin source.
An unset --plugin-source is never the current directory (Path('') == '.'); only an explicit nonempty source takes the local-plugin branch.

about: Vendored wizard-os source at commit plus the declared Mac local patch. sha256 covers actual distributed bytes; upstream_sha256 records the unpatched source. This is not a byte-identical upstream copy.
